text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Dot: estimate. Line: 97.5% interval from resampling whole calendar months. Grey rule: no change. Recall is the share of the MW moved by injected load transfers that sits in transfers the detector found, pooled over three transfer shapes, even months, at 80 or fewer unexplained alarms on odd months.'
text.tspan: Dot: estimate. Line: 97.5% interval from resampling whole calendar months. Grey
rule: no change. Recall is the share of the MW moved by injected load transfers
that sits in transfers the detector found, pooled over three transfer shapes,
even months, at 80 or fewer unexplained alarms on odd months.
